name: Indexer (contributes.tasks example)
description: EXAMPLE — a complete manifest showing contributes.tasks: one cheap agentic_output task that only notifies when its command exits non-zero, and one terminal task that fires a prompt into a CLI agent session. Validate with: python tests/validate_manifest.py examples/contributes-tasks/aw-app.json

tasks.name: Indexer — weekly staleness report
tasks.prompt: Run `indexer-cli status --json`, then report which indexes have not been rebuilt in over 7 days and what is likely blocking them. Keep it under ten lines.

apps.reason: Provides the contributes.tasks surface (it owns the task tables and the cron tick). Non-required on purpose: the declaration is HELD and replayed the moment a provider appears, so this app installs and works without it — the schedules just aren't seeded yet.
